name: Handout 11b: Shield of Horatius
player_description:
SHIELD OF HORATIUS
Carried at the Tiber bridge by a man who held alone.

Benefit: +3 AC. Reaction: impose disadvantage on one attack per round.
Cost: Cannot be used with a two-handed weapon.
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 5, Scene 2. Place face-down with the other arena weapon cards.
MECHANICS NOTE: The reaction (impose disadvantage) costs no resource — it is unlimited. This is intentional. Horatius held the bridge alone. The shield remembers. The cost (no two-handed weapons) is a genuine constraint for Barbarians and two-handed fighters.
